name: ingest_traces
description: Record observed runtime calls so the graph can distinguish observed from merely possible paths. Each trace is a call path (qualified names, adjacent = caller→callee) or a bare caller/callee pair. Stored per run label, keyed by qualified name (reindex-proof). Only pairs whose both endpoints are indexed symbols are stored; the response reports unresolved names (up to 10) so the producer can fix its naming.

label.description: Run identity, e.g. 'pytest 2026-08-27' (default 'unlabeled'); counts accumulate per label and whole runs age out together

count.description: How often this trace was observed (default 1)

path.description: Call path of qualified names, caller before callee; 2..256 entries
